text: For a hundred years, every car was built the same way. Tesla just threw that out.
They kept adding robots. And the line kept hitting a wall.
Because the problem wasn't the robots. It was the car.
Then someone said: a car is just a box. A front, a back, a top, two sides.
Build every piece on its own. Test it. Before it ever touches the car.
They secretly rehearsed it on the Cybertruck. Then every engineer moved into one room for three weeks. Nobody leaves until it works.
And then comes the craziest station of all.
The drivetrain waits on a pallet. And the whole car drops onto it. From above.
Twenty-five stations. Half the factory floor. No paint shop.
Tesla didn't build a better factory. It UNBOXED, THE, CAR.
